items.prompt:
A flaw in reasoning is called a:
A) fallacy
B) claim
C) title

Drawing a broad conclusion from too few cases is a:
A) hasty generalization
B) valid argument
C) definition

Attacking the person instead of their argument is an:
A) ad hominem attack
B) ethos appeal
C) analogy

'The rooster crows, then the sun rises; so the rooster causes the sunrise.' This is a:
A) false-cause fallacy
B) sound argument
C) valid proof

'My two neighbors litter, so everyone in the city is a litterbug' is a:
A) hasty generalization
B) strong argument
C) definition

steps: Too few cases. Key is A.

items.prompt:
A strong argument has:
A) valid reasoning and relevant, sufficient evidence
B) a personal attack
C) a single rare example
items.answer: A) valid reasoning and relevant, sufficient evidence

steps: Valid + relevant + sufficient. Key is A.
solution.answer: A) valid reasoning and relevant, sufficient evidence

items.prompt:
Read.

'Either we ban all cars, or the planet is doomed.'

This is a:
A) false dilemma (ignores other options)
B) sound argument
C) relevant statistic

steps: Only two options presented. Key is A.

items.prompt:
Read.

'You shouldn't believe her climate data because she once got a parking ticket.'

This is a(n):
A) ad hominem fallacy
B) valid rebuttal
C) relevant evidence

steps: Attacks her, not the data. Key is A.
